== Invitation ==

== Theme question discussion ==
* Look at the ones from the first three [[OpenSpace]]s
** [[Seed 2009]]: What does it mean to Bring Life to each of us, to all of us, and to the entire Galaxy?
** [[Sol 2009]]: Who are we? As Life, as individuals on a spiritual journey, and as members and friends of the [[SolSeed Movement]]?
** The first [[Longest Night Festival]]: Who are we becoming?  What are we doing next?


* General ideas
** Why community?
** Starting with Space and working back to here and now ... what do we want for community?
** If you could build any living situation (community or otherwise) for yourself ... what would you build?
** What community do we want to build? on Earth and in space?
** What if your community were a spaceship?
** We want to live in community.  What does that look like?  How do we live our values?
** How do we want to live in community? ...''in space?''
* Punnish ones
** How much Space do we need for our community?
** How do we make Space for community in our lives?
** Can community feel Space-ious?
** Is there Space for community in your life?
** What Space have you cleared for community in your life?
** Space for community in your life?
** Living together in one space?
** We live in one Space ... how can we thrive?

== Where ==
[http://www.amajesticmountainretreat.com/serenity.htm Serenity Lodge] on Mount Hood, about 1 hour from Portland (?)

The lodge sleeps 12 adults plus some children (how many?), and will provide cozy spaces for [[OpenSpace]] sessions.

Another open question: does it have an Internet connection?

February 5, 6, and a half day on February 7, 2011.  For more details see [[Seed 2011/Schedule|the schedule]].
